english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for the small dish used with a cup.

examples.english: Remember to use a saucer when drinking coffee, or it will drip onto the table.
examples.traditional: 飲咖啡嗰陣記得用杯碟，唔係會滴到張枱度。
